changeSet.author: medical-agent
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO sys_user (user_name,nick_name,password,status,del_flag,create_by,create_time,update_time) SELECT username,display_name,password_hash,IF(status='ACTIVE','0','1'),'0',created_by,created_at,updated_at FROM platform_local_account ORDER BY user_id

changeSet.author: medical-agent
changeSet.sql: UPDATE platform_local_account m JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_name=m.username SET m.ruoyi_user_id=u.user_id

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM platform_local_account m LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=m.ruoyi_user_id WHERE u.user_id IS NULL OR BINARY u.user_name != BINARY m.username OR BINARY u.nick_name != BINARY m.display_name OR BINARY u.password != BINARY m.password_hash OR u.status != IF(m.status='ACTIVE','0','1')

changeSet.author: medical-agent
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE platform_local_account DROP CHECK platform_local_account_chk_1, DROP CHECK platform_local_account_chk_4, DROP INDEX uq_platform_local_username

changeSet.author: medical-agent
changeSet.createView: SELECT m.user_id,u.user_name AS username,u.password AS password_hash, u.nick_name AS display_name,IF(u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0','ACTIVE','DISABLED') AS status, m.platform_role,m.failed_attempts,m.locked_until,m.credential_revision,m.created_by,m.created_at,m.classification, m.revision,m.updated_at,m.ruoyi_user_id FROM platform_local_identity_metadata m JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=m.ruoyi_user_id
